merged_prs.title: Fix main Clippy findings and scheduler, fence and admission oracles
Share revision policy programs and protected owner custody
Land incremental journal milestone with shared standalone custody
Qualify private gate artifacts and own coordinator dispatch

occupancy_all_repositories.note: Completed jobs only; receipt execution boundaries where present, legacy at/wall inferred; missing active jobs/capacity. Idle upper bound; saturation and CPU-hours unknown.

receipt_coverage.note: Admission overhead includes sync/probes/queue; not pure queue time. Nested remote receipts are not additional jobs. CPU counters have separate partial coverage.

compute.note: Partial coverage: waited child tree plus owned sccache CPU. Unawaited descendants and killed jobs can be absent. Phase is job label, not compile/test breakdown. No extrapolation to uninstrumented jobs.

batch_descendant_rerun_candidates.note: Strict subset verdicts within 2h of failed batch; candidates, not proof all were avoidable. Overlaps other categories.

repeated_conflict_candidates.note: Repeated PR conflicts, not proof of identical head/base or actual Git conflicts; inspect diagnostic logs. Span is not CPU time.

duplicate_tree_command_candidates.note: Exact full ledger tree + command; command may be an opaque script or intentional repeat. Not proven reusable verification.

regate_same_base_head_candidates.note: Same base+synthetic head; logs overwritten in place and gate version changes not observable.

discarded_long_jobs.note: Failure does not prove discarded work; no PR/tree disposition join.

spot_reclaim.note: No causal outage accounting inferred from absence of completed jobs.

review.note: Review submissions are a rounds proxy; P1 label alone does not establish self-review avoidability. Current thread snapshot, not historical blocking duration.

idle_lanes_with_work.note: Need coordinator dispatch/ready/queue events; absent completion events do not establish lane idleness.

limitations: Codex resumed counters are session-cumulative, deduplicated by session high-water. Completed summaries lack trustworthy run timestamps: inventory is not24h/account usage; deltas are newly observed counters, not necessarily tokens spent in the interval. Old sum-of-resumes inventories are superseded, not comparable.

Claude gross tokens include cache reads/creation, deduplicated by message ID using component-wise maximum; not dollars or directly comparable to Codex summaries. Coordinator usage outside task files unavailable.
Claude per-agent identity is available, but a reliable agent-to-lane mapping is absent. Branch main is shared by many agents and must not be treated as one lane.
Per-lane tokens are supplied; PR attribution is unknown without run-to-PR/tree events. Tokens per merge are fleet window ratios, not PR lifecycle costs.
Gate times use terminal alert time where available, otherwise filesystem mtime (proxy); overwritten same-name logs lose earlier runs.
Waste categories overlap. Gate logged wall includes orchestration, is not CPU time and is not additive to ledger job-hours.

Receipt execution/admission timestamps are reported separately; admission includes sync/probes, not just queue. New compute counters have explicit partial coverage; legacy CPU-hours and saturation remain unknown.
SDK-tagged jobs only; older untagged records excluded rather than guessed. GitHub review pagination capped at 100 entries per PR. Closed-unmerged is not proof of wasted work.
Claude task mtime filter retains two days around endpoint; old files modified later remain scanned. Historical backfills require retained sources.
